# Deploy Onboarding Guide

> A Chinese-first AI agent skill for assessing open-source software before installation and explaining setup, permissions, costs, and first use.

Maintainer: kevin-12-ou
Repository: https://github.com/kevin-12-ou/deploy-onboarding-guide
License: MIT
Skill name: deploy-onboarding-guide
Version: 1.0.0
Install: npx skills add kevin-12-ou/deploy-onboarding-guide --skill deploy-onboarding-guide

- [Agent instructions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kevin-12-ou/deploy-onboarding-guide/main/SKILL.md): capability and invocation scope.
- [English README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kevin-12-ou/deploy-onboarding-guide/main/README.md): examples, installation, and limitations.
- [中文说明](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kevin-12-ou/deploy-onboarding-guide/main/README.zh-CN.md): 用途、安装、示例和边界。
